name: ComfyUI (local image generation)
summary: Make AI pictures on your own computer for free. You need a strong computer.
gains: Huge community of models and styles
tradeoffs: Needs an NVIDIA GPU with 8 GB+ VRAM or a Mac with 16 GB+
Node-based interface takes time to learn
Check each model's license for commercial use
setupSteps: Load a starter workflow and download a recommended model
Type a prompt and queue it
commercialNote: Each image model has its own license; some don't allow commercial use without a paid license.
